'''Rolf Georg Schneider''' (born 17 March 1940, [[Hagen]], Germany)<ref>Lebens- und Karrieredaten Kürschner Gelehrtenkalender 2009</ref> is a mathematician. Schneider is a professor emeritus at the [[University of Freiburg]]. His main research interests are [[convex geometry]] and [[stochastic geometry]].

==Career==
Schneider completed his PhD 1967 with [[Ruth Moufang]] at [[Goethe University Frankfurt]] with a thesis titled  (''Elliptisch gekrümmte Hyperflächen in der affinen Differentialgeometrie im Großen''). In 1969, he got his Habilitation in Bochum. In 1970, he was appointed as a full professor at [[Technische Universität Berlin]] and in 1974 at the [[University of Freiburg]].

He became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title=American Mathematical Society|website=Ams.org|accessdate=25 March 2018}}</ref> in 2015 and received an honorary doctorate of the [[University of Salzburg]] in 2004.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.plus.ac.at/kommunikation-und-fundraising/news-events-social-media/preisverleihungen-und-ehrungen/tabula-honorum/| title = Tabula Honorum of the University of Salzburg| accessdate= 25 March 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title=Ehrenpromotion von Rolf Schneider in Salzburg (Laudatio of Ch. Buchta and response of R. Schneider) |journal=Int. Math. Nachr., Wien |date=2004 |volume=196 |pages=78-86 |url=https://www.oemg.ac.at/db/IMN/196 |access-date=26 March 2026 |ref=Laudatio}}</ref>


===Research===
Rolf Schneider is known for his solution of [[Shephard's problem]],<ref>{{cite journal| last = Schneider| first = Rolf|    title = Zu einem Problem von Shephard über die Projektionen konvexer Körper|  journal = Math. Z.|   volume = 101|     year = 1967|  pages = 71&ndash;82| language = German| doi = 10.1007/BF01135693| s2cid = 120282582}}</ref> his books on  stochastic and integral geometry in long-standing collaboration with [[Wolfgang Weil (mathematician)|Wolfgang Weil]],<ref>{{cite book | author=Schneider, Rolf | author2=Weil, Wolfgang | title=Integralgeometrie | publisher=Teubner | year=1992 | isbn=3-519-02734-8}}</ref><ref>{{cite book | author=Schneider, Rolf | author2=Weil, Wolfgang | title= Stochastische Geometrie| publisher= Teubner| location= Stuttgart | year=2000| isbn=3-519-02740-2}}</ref><ref>{{cite book | author=Schneider, Rolf | author2=Weil, Wolfgang | title= Stochastic and Integral Geometry| publisher= Springer| location= Berlin | year=2008| isbn=978-3-540-78858-4}}</ref> and his comprehensive monography on the Brunn–Minkowski theory.<ref>{{cite book | author=Schneider, Rolf | title=Convex Bodies: the Brunn-Minkowski Theory | url=https://archive.org/details/convexbodiesbrun0000schn | url-access=registration | publisher=Cambridge University Press | year=1993 | isbn=0-521-35220-7}}</ref><ref>{{cite book | author=Schneider, Rolf | title=Convex Bodies: the Brunn-Minkowski Theory. Second expanded Edition | publisher=Cambridge University Press | year=2014 | isbn=978-1-107-60101-7}}</ref>
